brief:
WHAT HAPPENED
- Millions of Americans are heading to the polls today for the midterm elections, which will shape the remainder of Donald Trump’s presidency.
- A significant cyber-attack has targeted supermarket freezers across seven European countries, causing temperatures to rise.
- The US has conducted limited, defensive strikes on Qeshm Island, Iran, ahead of the US midterm elections.
- Binance has frozen transactions following a record-breaking $6.3 billion crypto hack, leading to $3.6 billion in user withdrawals.
- US tech stocks have experienced sharp declines as total AI spending approaches $1 trillion, with Intel shares falling and the Nasdaq hitting a two-month low.

WHY IT MATTERS
- The US midterm results will determine control of Congress, directly influencing the legislative power of the current administration.
- The cyber-attack on European food infrastructure highlights growing vulnerabilities in internet-connected industrial technology.
- Crypto hacks of this scale can trigger a 'bank run'—where many users rush to withdraw their funds simultaneously—threatening the stability of digital asset exchanges.
- Tech sector volatility, driven by massive AI capital expenditure, can have a significant 'ripple effect' on broader market sentiment.

WHAT TO WATCH TODAY
- Ongoing updates regarding the US midterm election results and potential projections.
- Further developments in the investigation into the European supermarket cyber-attack.
- Market reactions to the ongoing instability at the Binance exchange.
- Any additional statements from US officials regarding the military strikes on Qeshm Island.

IN SIMPLE TERMS
Today is a pivotal day for US politics as voters decide the balance of power in Congress. Meanwhile, global markets are feeling the pressure from a massive $6.3 billion cryptocurrency hack and a cyber-attack that disrupted food refrigeration across Europe. Investors are also reacting to a cooling tech sector, as concerns grow over the massive costs associated with artificial intelligence development.
